$comment: One key per edge case from the brief's Feature Reference.

atMinimum.$comment: Minus becomes a delete affordance rather than a dead button.

atInventoryLimit.$comment: The reason is announced, not just implied by a disabled +.

minimumOrderQuantity.$comment: Wholesale: cannot go below 6, and steps in 6s.

fractionalWeight.$comment: Groceries sold by weight. 0.5 kg steps must not drift to 0.7999999.

unknownCeiling.$comment: No max supplied — the server has not confirmed a limit, so the + stays enabled.
